m1: Top-down static view of a clean white worktable with soap-making materials neatly arranged in rows: a large white plastic bucket, a digital kitchen scale, a clear measuring jug, small white bowls of white powder, a brown plastic jerrycan, a tub of clear gel, a bag of salt, small bottles and a pack of test strips. Bright even daylight.
m2: Slow sideways camera move along a clean white worktable with neatly arranged soap-making ingredients in labelled containers, a digital scale, a measuring jug and a large white plastic bucket. Bright daylight, plain grey wall.
m3: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A gloved hand places two small white plastic bowls next to a large white plastic bucket on the table.
p1: An African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, wearing clear safety goggles, blue nitrile gloves, a long-sleeved white top and a grey apron, at a clean white tiled worktable against a plain light grey wall, soft daylight. She puts on clear safety goggles, medium shot.
p2: Close-up of a woman pulling a blue nitrile glove over her hand and wrist, long white sleeve, clean white table, soft daylight.
p3: Medium shot of an African woman tying a grey apron around her waist over a long-sleeved white top, plain light grey wall, soft daylight.
p4: An African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, wearing clear safety goggles, blue nitrile gloves, a long-sleeved white top and a grey apron, at a clean white tiled worktable against a plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Wide shot, she stands ready behind the table with a large white plastic bucket, a measuring jug and a bucket of rinse water beside her.
s1a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Pouring clear water from a 1-litre plastic measuring jug into a large white plastic bucket.
s1b: Top-down view into a large white plastic bucket being filled with clean clear water, ripples on the surface, soft daylight.
s2a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A small bowl of fine white powder sits on a digital kitchen scale; the gloved hand adds a little more powder with a spoon.
s2b: An African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, wearing clear safety goggles, blue nitrile gloves, a long-sleeved white top and a grey apron, at a clean white tiled worktable against a plain light grey wall, soft daylight. She slowly sprinkles fine white powder from a small bowl over a large white bucket of water while stirring with a long wooden stick.
s2c: Top-down view into a large white bucket: a wooden stick stirs water in circles while fine white powder swirls on the surface. Soft daylight.
s2d: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A wooden stick is lifted out of a large white bucket of thick clear gel, the gel drips slowly from the stick.
s3a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. White flakes are added slowly from a small scoop into a small white plastic bowl of water and stirred with a plastic spoon.
s3b: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Fine white powder is stirred into water in a second small white plastic bowl until it dissolves.
s4a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A plastic jug of thick dark brown liquid stands on a digital kitchen scale.
s4b: An African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, wearing clear safety goggles, blue nitrile gloves, a long-sleeved white top and a grey apron, at a clean white tiled worktable against a plain light grey wall, soft daylight. She slowly pours a thin stream of thick dark brown liquid from a plastic jug into a large white bucket, leaning her face back.
s4c: Close-up of a thin stream of thick dark brown liquid pouring into thick clear gel inside a white bucket, soft daylight.
s4d: Close-up of a wooden stick stirring thick liquid in circles inside a large white bucket, brown swirls blending into pale liquid.
s5a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Clear liquid is poured slowly from a small white bowl into a large white bucket while a wooden stick stirs.
s5b: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A spoon scoops a small sample of pale liquid from a large bucket into a small clear cup.
s5c: Macro close-up of a blue-gloved hand dipping a paper pH test strip into a small cup of pale liquid soap and lifting it out. Clean white table, daylight.
s5d: Macro close-up of fizzing bubbles rising on the surface of pale liquid in a white bucket as clear liquid is poured in.
s6a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A spoon scoops thick clear gel paste from a white tub into a large white bucket of pale liquid.
s6b: Close-up of a wooden stick stirring slowly and gently in a large white bucket of smooth pale liquid soap, a little soft foam on top.
s7a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Salt is poured from a small bowl into a measuring jug of water and stirred until it dissolves.
s7b: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A small cup of clear salt water is poured into a large white bucket of pale liquid soap while a wooden stick stirs.
s7c: Close-up of a small plastic cup with a hole in the bottom held above a white bucket, thick pale liquid soap streaming out of the hole in a thin steady stream.
s8a: Close-up of a small amount of bright green dye solution poured into a large white bucket of pale liquid soap, green colour swirling and spreading as a wooden stick stirs.
s8b: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Clear perfume is poured from a small measuring jug into a white bucket of green liquid soap.
s8c: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A dropper adds a few drops of clear liquid into a white bucket of green liquid soap.
s9a: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A white lid is pressed onto a large white plastic bucket.
s9b: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. Green liquid soap is poured through a white funnel into a clear 1-litre plastic bottle.
s9c: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A white cap is screwed tightly onto a clear bottle full of green liquid soap.
s9d: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A black marker writes on a white label stuck to a bottle of green liquid soap.
s9e: A neat row of clear 1-litre bottles of green liquid soap with white caps and white labels on a clean white table, slow camera push in, soft daylight.
x1: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A sponge with green liquid soap washes cooking oil off a white plate in a basin; the plate comes out clean and shiny.
x2: Close-up of hands washing with green liquid soap and rich white lather over a white basin, clean bright bathroom, soft daylight.
x3: An African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, wearing clear safety goggles, blue nitrile gloves, a long-sleeved white top and a grey apron, at a clean white tiled worktable against a plain light grey wall, soft daylight. She smiles and holds up a bottle of green liquid soap with a white label towards the camera.
x4: Close-up of hands in blue nitrile gloves at a clean white tiled worktable, plain light grey wall, soft daylight. A plastic syringe draws up 10 ml of clear liquid from a small bottle.
